title: Unbound Recursive — stats-only snapshot
description: Operator-exported stats_noreset snapshots, no administrative socket access.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "unbound_snapshot" and r.service == "unbound-recursive" and (r._field == "total_num_queries"))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)

  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
